result.title: GazeRIB: Systematic Evaluation of Multi-Reader Gaze-Guided Chest X-ray Learning
result.comment: 20 pages on main manuscripts (3 tables + 4 figures), 14 pages supplementary (10 tables + 8 figures)
result.summary: Radiologists' visual attention can supervise medical image learning, but how reader panel composition affects its value remains untested. We evaluated GazeRIB (Gaze-guided Radiologist-Informed Blackout), which masks unviewed regions during training and uses unmasked images at inference. Eight experts repeatedly read the same 80 chest X-rays (CXRs). We compared individual readers with three-, five- and eight-reader panels across seven architectures and 10 seeds, evaluating 910 models on a separate 2,897-CXR cohort for four-class severity prediction. Every panel improved macro F1 over the no-gaze baseline by 5.33-7.47 percentage points (pp; Bonferroni-adjusted p < 0.007); no individual reader reached significance on this endpoint. Three readers captured 73-80% of the eight-reader gain in macro F1, the area under the receiver-operating-characteristic curve (ROC-AUC) and the area under the precision-recall curve (AU-PRC). On external validation without retraining, all four panels improved ROC-AUC on SIIM-FISABIO-RSNA by +1.93 to +4.24 pp (p <= 0.004); on MIMIC-Eye no panel differed significantly from baseline, whereas the single-reader average declined (-1.40 pp, p = 0.008). Reader composition therefore influenced performance, although transfer depended on the cohort.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文系统评估 GazeRIB：训练时用放射科医生注视掩码遮挡未被注视区域、推理时使用原图，在 80 张胸片、1/3/5/8 位读片者组合、7 种架构与 10 个随机种子上训练 910 个模型，考察四类严重度预测及外部验证的迁移表现。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「以注视掩码筛选视觉证据」的训练期监督思路可能为 LVR 的视觉证据筛选与贡献分配提供参照，但任务是医学影像分类、不涉及 latent 推理状态，联系需人工核查。
